title: Capstone Network
description: A boomtown, a scouted outpost, a cargo depot, and a hub-limit — everything you've learned, one network.

narrative.intro: Last network before this sector's fully open: seed a boomtown, get intel on the depot, keep cargo flowing, and don't let any single outpost carry more than 3 routes. Nothing new here — just everything at once.
narrative.outro: No new mechanic this time, on purpose. Every piece — typed routes, organic growth, sustained thresholds, a degree limit — had already been introduced on its own. The only thing capstone about this one was making them all hold at the same time.

goals.description: Let the boomtown grow to at least 6 population.
Hold the Depot's cargo at or above 5 for 6 straight ticks.
Deliver at least 5 intel to the Watchpost.
No outpost may have more than 3 routes connected to it.
